jobs.title: IT Service Desk & SLA Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The IT Service Desk & SLA Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of all IT support tickets, from initial intake through resolution and closure. This role demands unrelenting ownership: you will follow every ticket on its entire journey to the end-of-the-earth to achieve resolution in a timely and effective manner.

Driven by a "Simple Sets You Free" mindset, this role actively strips away bureaucratic friction, eliminates operational waste, and continuously optimizes IT service management processes to maximize efficiency, speed up ticket resolution, and boost customer satisfaction.
In This Role, You Will...
End-to-End Ticket Ownership & Lifecycle Management

- Relentless Resolution Ownership: Personally track and follow tickets on their entire journey to the end-of-the-earth, taking total responsibility until issues are thoroughly, accurately, and effectively resolved.

- Queue Administration & Triage: Monitor, triage, and assign incoming incidents, service requests, and problem tickets across multi-tiered support teams with speed and accuracy. ● Closure & Quality Control: Validate that all tickets are properly documented, root causes are identified, and end-users confirm resolution before ticket closure.

- Escalation Management: Identify aging, stuck, or high-priority (P1/P2) tickets and proactively cross organizational boundaries to drive action and prevent SLA breaches.

Process Optimization & Friction Elimination ("Simple Sets You Free")

- Bottleneck Identification: Continuously audit ticket lifecycles, intake workflows, and escalation paths to pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant approvals, or process inefficiencies that delay issue reporting and resolution.

- Streamlined Workflows: Design and implement intuitive, simplified ticketing processes and self-service channels that make it effortless for users to report issues and for technicians to resolve them.

- Root-Cause Process Fixing: Collaborate across IT and business departments to re-engineer flawed processes, remove unnecessary handoffs, and eliminate administrative bloat slowing down resolution times.

- Automation & Lean Operations: Champion lean service desk practices by eliminating obsolete procedures, automating routine tasks, and establishing straightforward, zero-friction standards across all support tiers.

SLA & Metric Tracking

- SLA Monitoring: Enforce and monitor compliance against core SLAs (First Response Time, Mean Time to Resolution [MTTR], First Contact Resolution [FCR], and Customer Satisfaction [CSAT]).

- Reporting & Dashboards: Design, build, and maintain real-time operational dashboards and weekly/monthly executive report packs using ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk).

- Trend Analysis: Analyze incident data to detect recurring technical issues, capacity bottlenecks, or process failures, feeding insights directly into Problem Management.

Process Governance & Continuous Improvement

- ITIL & Lean Governance: Standardize and enforce streamlined incident management processes, simplified escalation pathways, and consistent ticket categorization/tagging.

- Vendor & Cross-Team Coordination: Hold internal technical teams and external IT vendors accountable to contractual response and resolution targets while streamlining joint operational workflows.

- Customer Feedback: Manage the CSAT survey process, follow up on negative feedback, and implement actionable improvement plans based on direct user input.
Qualifications
-   3–5+ years in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations, or Service Desk leadership roles with demonstrated experience in end-to-end ticket management and lean process optimization.

- Unwavering ownership mentality—willing to follow a ticket to the end-of-the-earth to see it resolved.

- Strong lean operational mindset focused on process simplification and waste reduction.

- Advanced proficiency in ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, BMC Helix, Freshservice, etc.).

- Deep expertise in analytics/BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Excel/Google Sheets advanced reporting).
Bonus Qualifications
- ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification

- Excellent written/verbal communication

- Strong analytical problem-solving

- Proven ability to simplify complex technical workflows under tight SLA timelines
About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

jobs.title: Procurement Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Procurement & Strategic Partnerships (PSP) team at Zoox builds the sourcing, contracting, and supplier relationships that keep our autonomous vehicle mission moving forward. We work at the intersection of operations, finance, and technology, bringing the same rigor and care to procurement that we bring to the vehicles we build. You'll join a team that values ownership, clear communication, and continuous improvement.
 
As Zoox scales, so does the complexity of sourcing and managing the services that support our business. In this role, you'll take on a variety of responsibilities, from supporting the deployment of a new business process outsourcing (BPO) relationship to helping drive the process improvements that make procurement work better for everyone at Zoox. You'll have the opportunity to build from the ground up, deepen your knowledge of enterprise procurement operations, and grow your program and project management skills along the way.

In this role you will :
-
Support the deployment and day-to-day oversight of a Managed Service Provider (MSP) BPO engagement covering offshore BuyDesk, sourcing support, supplier management, and contracting support.

-
Help build standard operating procedures (SOPs), governance, and escalation workflows for the BPO relationship.

-
Track and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to hold the BPO accountable for service quality.

-
Participate in procurement operations improvement projects that streamline how the business sources, buys, and manages suppliers.

-
Partner with stakeholders across Zoox to translate their requests into practical, scalable solutions

-
Manage multiple projects at once, prioritizing your time and resources as needs shift.

-
Use Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platforms such as Zip and Ariba to support requisitions, purchase orders, and invoice workflows across day-to-day procurement operations
Qualifications:
-
Track record of converting stakeholder pain points into practical, scalable solutions

-
Experience managing multiple projects at once, prioritizing time and resources across competing priorities

-
Experience supporting the deployment and day-to-day operation of procurement-support delivery covering areas such as BuyDesk, sourcing support, supplier management, and contracting support, including implementing SOPs, program coordination, escalation workflows, and KPI/SLA management

-
Practical, hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platforms, including requisition, purchase order, and invoice workflows
Bonus Qualifications:
-
College degree with a concentration in a relevant field such as supply chain, business, or operations

-
At least 5 years of experience in and around corporate procurement

-
Experience with commercial procurement AI solutions

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, People Experience
jobs.description:
Zoox is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to join our People Experience (PEx) team, serving as PEx PMO's strategic partner to our Talent Acquisition organization. This role owns the planning, reporting, and vendor infrastructure that lets Talent hire efficiently and confidently at scale — from hiring capacity models to executive reporting to our large-scale industry conference presence. We're looking for someone with strong program management skills and real Talent Acquisition operations experience who can build the systems Talent leadership relies on to make good decisions. As PEx's needs evolve, this person will also be expected to take on new projects and departments beyond Talent.
Responsibilities
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead Talent Operations initiatives end-to-end — including the Referral Rewards Program, requisition administration, process improvement efforts, and tooling rollouts.

- Strategic Translation & Execution: Own enterprise Hiring Goals capacity planning methodology, translating business growth targets into concrete hiring plans in partnership with Talent leadership and HRIS.

- Event & Conference Operations: Own end-to-end planning and execution for large-scale industry conferences (e.g., CVPR), including budget, vendor management, and operational logistics — plus lighter-touch support for smaller industry events.
Interviewing & Enablement Support: Provide light-touch support for interview standardization (playbooks, calibration) and Talent enablement initiatives (onboarding curriculum, SOPs) as needed.

- Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary point of contact between PEx PMO and the Talent organization, partnering closely with Recruiting leadership, HRIS, and Legal to ensure alignment across initiatives.
Talent Tooling & Vendor Management: Own relationships with core Talent tooling vendors (Lever, Gem, LinkedIn, ModernLoop, and others), partnering on tool roadmap decisions and budget/contract planning.

- Governance & Reporting: Own executive-facing reporting, including the Monthly Hiring Report, and partner with HRIS on data governance and quality for Talent's Workday-based reporting infrastructure.
Initiative-Based Responsibilities
- Hiring Goals & Capacity Planning: Build and maintain the methodology Zoox uses to plan hiring capacity against business growth targets — one of the most complex, least-documented pieces of Talent's operating model today.

- AI in Talent: Partner with Legal/Employment Law on the responsible adoption of AI tools and processes within interviewing and recruiting — a high-sensitivity, cross-functional initiative requiring careful, thoughtful execution.
Qualifications
- 8+ years of relevant program management experience, with a focus on Talent Acquisition operations, recruiting program management, or workforce/hiring capacity planning.

- Proven experience designing and delivering scalable operational programs in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong functional expertise in recruiting/TA systems and tooling (e.g., Lever, Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent).

- Analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience building data-driven planning models.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and stakeholders.

- Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or similar functions on sensitive, high-visibility initiatives.

- Strong group facilitation and presentation skills across a variety of formats.

- Experience planning and executing large-scale conferences, corporate events, or offsites, including budget and vendor management.

If you are ready to adapt to new challenges, take on new roles as needed, and hit deadlines, we would love to hear from you. If you’re not shy about herding cats and managing chaos, then this role was made for you!

jobs.title: Manager, Procurement & Strategic Partnerships - Chassis
jobs.description:
The Manager, Procurement & Strategic Partnerships will lead a high-performing procurement team responsible for the end-to-end strategic sourcing, commercial execution, and lifecycle management of Zoox’s chassis control portfolio, including suspension, braking, and steering systems. Operating in a demanding, fast-paced environment, this role blends people leadership with commercial execution - driving global supplier strategies, leading contract negotiations, and partnering closely with Engineering, Program, Quality and Finance to meet vehicle cost, quality, and production milestones.

In this role, you will:
-
Team Leadership & Integrity: Build, scale, and mentor a high-performing procurement team while maintaining compliance with company policies and the highest standard of professional ethics.

-
Sourcing Strategy: Lead the end-to-end RFI/RFQ/RFP processes and develop long-term global sourcing strategies for chassis components to minimize cost and optimize terms.

-
Commercial Negotiations: Lead complex negotiations for master supply agreements, production statements of work and secure best-in-class pricing.

-
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Engineering and Finance to build 3–5 year technology and costing roadmaps, ensuring technical requirements meet Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and vehicle margin targets.

-
Supplier & Risk Management: Map the supply chain, evaluate supplier performance, and leverage data analysis to mitigate supply chain risks, ensure business continuity, and maintain automotive PPAP standards.
Qualifications
-
Industry Experience: 10+ years of purchasing, procurement, or commodity management experience within the automotive chassis, vehicle dynamics, or heavy industrial manufacturing industry preferred, comparable electro mechanical experience will also be considered.

-
People Leadership: Minimum 3+ years of dedicated experience directly managing, mentoring, and leading a team of purchasing professionals.

-
Technical Acumen: Working knowledge of chassis product development, vehicle dynamics, and advanced manufacturing processes (e.g., forging, casting, machining, and mechanical/electromechanical assembly) preferred.

-
Data & Analytics: Strong capabilities in organizing complex data, bid leveling, and financial forecasting, with high proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets.

-
Communication & Influence: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills to build alignment and influence internal and cross functional stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
As Strategic Sourcing Manager of Direct Procurement, you will be responsible for Zoox’s strategic sourcing and industry partnerships, which includes working cross-functionally to understand needs for third-party engagement across the business, finding and evaluating potential partners and suppliers, drafting and issuing RFQs, leading the negotiation of all key terms and conditions as well as pricing, managing commercial and supply chain issues, identifying and executing on cost reduction opportunities, and overall management of third party relationships. You can operate independently and possess expertise in electronics, powertrain, chassis, body, safety systems, EV charging, fleet maintenance or capital equipment.

In this role, you will:
- Lead procurement and partnership initiatives for vehicle direct materials (interiors, structural components, advanced hardware) and/or operations infrastructure (EV charging, vehicle maintenance, capital equipment)

- Proactively engage with Zoox stakeholders (incl. engineering, operations, manufacturing, strategy, finance, and design) to derive and execute the medium-term (3-5 years) business and technology roadmap to support Zoox’s vehicle development program and autonomous ride-hailing service

- Develop the supply chain and partnership footprint with a long-term, strategic view

- Lead the day-to-day process of ensuring successful partnerships (milestone adherence, change order management, quality assurance, cost control, etc.) and build supplier performance assessments to support future sourcing decisions

- Design, conduct, and synthesize supplier, industry, and market research

- Drive cost transparency and build total cost of ownership models to support sourcing decisions

- Ensure optimal contract coverage for the commodity/service in partnership with engineering and legal support

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers as the lead point of contact for all commercial issues

- Review, analyze, and finalize quote packages from suppliers

- Support and inform internal stakeholders with respect to supplier selection and management

- Identify sourcing alternatives to drive efficiencies via benchmarking, competitive quotes, and changing requirements
 Qualifications
- 6+ years of experience in partnership development and/or purchasing in a hardware product environment

- Bachelor’s degree

- Strategic sourcing, financial and business opportunity analysis, comfort with legal frameworks, and contract negotiation skills (development, supply, licensing, and service agreements)

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including C-level, engineering, legal, finance, manufacturing, and logistics

- Excellent analytical skills

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Bonus Qualifications
- Ability to analyze and interpret market trends relevant to pricing.

- Proven ability to cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers.

- Strong focus on cost management and optimization.

- Experience in evaluating and optimizing Bill of Materials (BOM) costs in collaboration with suppliers.

- Ability to work collaboratively with engineering teams on cost optimization projects, including sourcing low-cost electrical alternatives.

- Strategic mindset for negotiating costs with key component suppliers.

jobs.title: Staff Compensation Manager
jobs.description:
The Staff Compensation Manager plays a critical role in shaping and advancing the organization’s compensation strategy to support business growth, scalability, and talent outcomes. This role is responsible for leading executive (M5+) compensation, driving strategic compensation programs, and developing market-informed approaches that enable the company to compete effectively across geographies and talent segments.

Responsibilities include designing and evolving compensation frameworks, supporting complex and high-impact decisions, and delivering forward-looking insights based on market data and internal trends. The role partners closely with senior leadership, People Partners, Finance, and Recruiting to ensure compensation strategies are aligned with business priorities.

In addition, this role builds scalable tools, frameworks, and analytical approaches that improve consistency and decision quality across the organization. The Staff Compensation Manager also plays a key role in integrating compensation strategies into broader Total Rewards programs and may serve as a successor path to Head of Compensation as the function continues to scale. 
 

In this role, you will... 
- Lead and support high-impact compensation initiatives such as job architecture evolution, organizational design changes, and  M&A integration.

- Provide analysis and recommendations to support senior leadership decisions on complex compensation matters.

- Lead the design and evolution of executive (M5+) compensation frameworks, including base, equity, and incentive structures- leveraging market insights and robust best practices.

- Ensure executive compensation decisions are aligned with company strategy, internal equity, and external competitiveness.

- Develop frameworks that enable consistent and scalable approaches to compensation across the organization.

- Partner cross-functionally to ensure compensation strategies align with broader People and business initiatives.

- Develop and maintain market pricing strategies across roles, functions, and geographies.

- Support expansion into new cities and markets by providing competitive, data-driven compensation recommendations.

- Analyze external market trends and internal data to inform proactive compensation strategies.

- Leverage data to generate insights that inform compensation decisions and highlight risks or opportunities.

- Build and refine models to support workforce planning, retention analysis, and compensation scenarios.

- Provide structured options and tradeoffs to guide senior leadership decision-making.

- Design and implement tools, templates, and frameworks that improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability of compensation processes.

- Partner with Compensation Analysts and HRIS to ensure data integrity and effective system integration.

- Partner with People Partners, Finance, Recruiting, and business leaders to align compensation strategies with business needs.

- Act as a trusted advisor on complex and sensitive compensation topics.

- Support integration of compensation within the broader Total Rewards strategy, including alignment with benefits programs.
Qualfications 
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field (Master’s degree or relevant certifications are a plus).

- 8+ years of experience in compensation, with exposure to executive compensation and strategic program work.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in modeling and data-driven decision-making.

- Deep understanding of compensation practices, market benchmarking, and regulatory considerations.

- Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and drive clarity through structured thinking.

- Strong communication and influencing skills, including the ability to engage with senior leaders.

- Proven ability to build scalable tools, frameworks, and processes.

- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
About Zoox

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
As Strategic Sourcing Manager of Direct Procurement, you will be responsible for Zoox’s strategic sourcing and industry partnerships, which includes working cross-functionally to understand needs for third-party engagement across the business, finding and evaluating potential partners and suppliers, drafting and issuing RFQs, leading the negotiation of all key terms and conditions as well as pricing, managing commercial and supply chain issues, identifying and executing on cost reduction opportunities, and overall management of third party relationships. You can operate independently and possess expertise in electronics, powertrain, chassis, body, safety systems, EV charging, fleet maintenance or capital equipment.

In this role, you will:
- Lead procurement and partnership initiatives for vehicle direct materials (interiors, structural components, advanced hardware) and/or operations infrastructure (EV charging, vehicle maintenance, capital equipment)

- Proactively engage with Zoox stakeholders (incl. engineering, operations, manufacturing, strategy, finance, and design) to derive and execute the medium-term (3-5 years) business and technology roadmap to support Zoox’s vehicle development program and autonomous ride-hailing service

- Develop the supply chain and partnership footprint with a long-term, strategic view

- Lead the day-to-day process of ensuring successful partnerships (milestone adherence, change order management, quality assurance, cost control, etc.) and build supplier performance assessments to support future sourcing decisions

- Design, conduct, and synthesize supplier, industry, and market research

- Drive cost transparency and build total cost of ownership models to support sourcing decisions

- Bachelor’s degree

- Strategic sourcing, financial and business opportunity analysis, comfort with legal frameworks, and contract negotiation skills (development, supply, licensing, and service agreements)

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Production Manufacturing
jobs.description:
The FP&A team at Zoox drives financial analysis of key strategic investments, maintains short and long term financial models, and develops reporting for both internal and external stakeholders.
As a Financial Analyst supporting Production Manufacturing, you will partner with several Manufacturing groups, Supply Chain, and Accounting teams to drive financial planning and MEC activities. You will own critical manufacturing KPIs, including inventory, BOM, and open PO planning, manage monthly S&OP cycles and close activities related to product costing. 
This role requires a solid understanding of cost accounting systems and processes as well as financial planning and reporting in a manufacturing environment. You will leverage SAP, Anaplan, and other reporting systems to analyze large financial datasets and provide actionable insights that influence operational strategy and manufacturing efficiency.

In this role you will:
- Own inventory, BOM, open PO, and other manufacturing KPI planning and reporting

- Support monthly S&OP and forecast variance reporting to Finance, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain leadership

- Manage close activities including accruals and allocations for product costing

- Analyze large financial datasets from Anaplan, SAP S4, SAP Ariba, and other internal data systems to drive actionable insights

- Support implementation of systems required for production manufacturing through design, build, testing, and cutover phases
Qualifications
- BA/BS degree, preferably in a Finance, Accounting, Data Science or a quantitative field

- 4+ years experience in an FP&A or other analytical field

- 2+ years of direct experience building models, forecast input templates, dashboards, and business process development in a manufacturing environment

- Experience with product costing and financial analysis in a manufacturing environment

- Experience working directly with best-in-class planning and reporting tools (Anaplan, OneStream, Looker, etc)

- Highly analytical, with proven ability to synthesize and analyze large amounts of data to develop clear insights and recommendations

- Ability to  develop strong, cross-functional working relationships across the finance team and beyond
Bonus Qualifications
- Experience in OEM, robotics or other high-tech manufacturing industries

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Commercial Operations Analyst at Zoox, you will help build and run the operational engine that drives our commercial P&L. Sitting at the center of our commercial business, you will turn pricing, promotions, and demand signals into the day-to-day and week-to-week decisions that move our growth and profitability targets—and stand up the rigor and rhythm that lets us manage those levers as we scale.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable in the data and in the operating cadence of a fast-moving business. You will partner closely with Product, Data Science, Fleet Operations, and Finance to translate complex commercial dynamics into clear actions, while helping establish the foundational processes that a growing Central Market Management team will be built on. It is ideal for a technical, structured operator who is energized by ambiguity and excited to shape how an autonomous mobility business is run. 

In this role you will:
- Run strategic pricing and promotions operations—standing up and owning the recurring processes to make, monitor, and evaluate pricing and promo decisions, and continuously assess how our commercial systems are performing.

- Own the weekly rhythm of commercial health monitoring, building the metrics, reporting, and review cadences (e.g., market and system health, experiment readouts) that surface issues and guide lever decisions across the business.

- Partner with Finance to translate commercial systems outputs and decisions into P&L impact, helping connect pricing, promos, and demand actions to cost, profit, and bookings outcomes.

- Translate supply-demand dynamics into operational inputs—working with Fleet Orchestration and Fleet

- Operations to inform parameterization, vehicle-hour targets, and demand management across waitlist, gating, and dynamic pricing.

- Synthesize messy operational and financial data into clear, decision-ready recommendations and narratives for cross-functional partners and leadership.
Qualifications
-  6+ years of experience in a quantitative, high-output role—e.g., analytics, data science, strategy & operations, management consulting, investment banking, or a comparable operating role (ideally within mobility, logistics, marketplaces, or tech).

- Strong technical foundation, with proficiency in SQL and Excel/Sheets and the ability to independently pull, structure, and analyze large, disparate datasets; comfort writing Python (or similar) to accelerate analysis is expected.

- A degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (e.g., economics, finance, data science, engineering, or a related field); advanced degrees (MS or MBA) welcome.

- Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solver who goes beyond surface metrics to understand underlying drivers, with strong analytical rigor and a high bar for accuracy in data that informs business and leadership decisions.

- Ability to distill complex analysis into concise storytelling and to operate effectively across functions in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
Bonus Qualifications
- Experience standing up new operational processes, metrics, or reporting rhythms from scratch (vs. running an established playbook).

- Familiarity with pricing, promotions, demand/supply forecasting, or marketplace economics.

- Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, etc.) and/or advanced analytics tooling (Python, R, Databricks).

jobs.title: Program Manager, Fleet Support Specialists
jobs.description:
Zoox's BaseOps Fleet Support team keeps our autonomous fleet healthy, ready, and on the road. We are seeking a Program Manager to join the BaseOps Fleet Support Specialist Team and drive the changes, improvements, and processes behind fleet uptime. Working closely with Fleet Support leadership and the teams that carry out the work each day, you will turn our standards for fleet readiness, scheduling, and repair support into consistent practice at every Zoox site. You will own process change from design through implementation and adherence, and close the communication gaps between BaseOps, Logistics, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Fleet Operations.

You will also be the BaseOps lead for the systems our shops run on, including SAP, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), and Jira, making sure our processes are built into those systems and that every site uses them consistently.
 
Travel Requirement: ~35%
Shift: 1st Shift, Monday - Friday, 7am - 4pm

In this role, you will:
- Drive improvement priorities: Partner with Fleet Support leadership to set improvement priorities for the CoE, and work with Fleet Support Specialists, technicians, and site leads to deliver them across sites

- Own process change and implementation: Design, pilot, and roll out new and improved processes, with clear SOPs, training, and change management so changes stick at every site

- Drive adherence: Define standards and audits for scheduling, work order quality, parts, documentation, and system data, track compliance by site, and close gaps with site leads

- Ensure fleet readiness: Make sure daily robot health reviews, down-vehicle tracking, and return-to-service follow-ups happen consistently and lead to action

- Govern scheduling: Make sure repairs, reworks, planned maintenance, calibrations, and inspections are scheduled and dispatched only when parts, tools, documentation, approvals, and vehicle time are in place

- Lead systems readiness: Represent BaseOps on SAP and FSM from requirements and UAT through cutover, training, and adoption, and make sure our processes are reflected in the systems

- Close communication gaps: Set the cadence, channels, and escalation paths (Slack, Jira, recurring check-ins) that keep Logistics, Manufacturing, Engineering, Fleet Operations, and sites aligned on vehicle updates, configuration, and documentation

- Measure and report: Maintain dashboards for uptime, MTBF, MTTR, days down, labor time adherence, and process compliance, and report status, risks, and results to leadership
Qualifications
- BS or MS degree in engineering, operations management, or equivalent experience

- 8+ years of experience in program management, operations, or maintenance planning in a fleet, automotive, aerospace, or similar service environment

- Experience driving accountability and adoption across teams and sites without direct authority

- Proven track record of designing, implementing, and sustaining process change across multiple teams or sites

- Hands-on experience with SAP or a similar ERP or maintenance management system, including supporting a rollout through UAT and go-live

- Proficient in tools required to manage complex programs (i.e. Jira, Confluence, Slack, Gantt charts, Looker, etc.)

- Clear, concise communicator who can align technicians, engineers, and leaders around priorities and decisions
Bonus Qualifications
- Experience working in a center of excellence, PMO, or operational excellence function

- SAP FSM or other field service management experience

- Program management or Lean Six Sigma certification

- Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, or vehicle manufacturing
